histoire.title: Chalon dans la rue Festival of Arts in Public Spaces - Chalon Dans la Rue

blocks.text: THE CHALON DANS LA RUE FESTIVAL IN A FEW WORDS

A landmark of creation in public space, the Chalon dans la rue festival reflects what is happening in street arts today. Every year, nearly 150 French and international companies take over Chalon-sur-Saône.

Artistic projects are either selected: In Selection, Authors in Tandem
or programmed: Off Selection

No form and no discipline is favored.
Historic companies mingle with younger ones, street arts with digital arts, live performance with performance art. Some works question society, while others play the night owls, sidestep “formatted formats,” offer other temporalities or follow more classic paths.
For 4 days, the city becomes a vast field of expression where new modes of dialogue between artists, city, works and audiences are imagined.
4 days

Around 150 French
and international companies
704 performances
1,000 professionals and programmers

blocks.text: Institutional Partners
JOIN US:
Support Chalon dans la rue!

As a company, you can take part in the Chalon dans la rue project through cultural patronage. Material or financial support, with nothing expected in return, makes your company a major player in the festival.

Supporting Chalon dans la rue means associating your image with that of a creative, popular international festival open to all artistic forms. A festival to which audiences and residents are particularly attached, rooted in the city and its territory.
Become a patron of Chalon dans la rue

Today, patronage is simple and quick to set up. It is defined as “material support given without direct return to the donor for a work or a person carrying out activities in the general interest.” Thanks to the 2003 law, a donation to Chalon dans la rue gives the patron tax benefits.
Become a partner

Several companies take part in the activity of Chalon dans la rue through products and services. This help is precious to us. A Daunat sandwich on frantic festival days, a Monika coffee, a bus carrying our volunteers thanks to Transdev, wheelchairs lent by the APF.
If you too would like to take part in this wild adventure that is Chalon dans la rue, contact our team. We will build the partnership that suits you.

commercants.title: Patron Merchants - Chalon Dans la Rue

blocks.text: Chalon dans la rue has a special bond with the city's merchants

Major players in the territory, they are in direct contact with the festival and its audiences. Every year, merchants support us and accompany our actions. This partnership goes beyond the festival and continues throughout the season. Merchants are kept informed of our activities, invited to events and called on for actions, occasionally or over the long term.
Becoming a patron merchant means supporting a festival that has become a real stake for the attractiveness of the urban area, and also becoming an accomplice of Chalon dans la rue.

II. Cookie policy

When you first connect to the Chalon dans la rue website, a banner at the bottom of your screen warns you that information about your browsing may be saved in files called “cookies.” Our cookie policy helps you better understand the measures we apply to browsing on our website. In particular, it informs you of all the cookies present on our website and their purpose (part I) and gives you the steps to configure them (part II).
1. General information on the cookies present on the Chalon dans la rue site
Chalon dans la rue, as publisher of this website, may place a cookie on the hard drive of your device (computer, tablet, mobile, etc.) in order to ensure smooth and optimal browsing on our website.
“Cookies” (or connection tokens) are small text files of limited size that allow us to recognize your computer, tablet or mobile in order to personalize the services we offer you.

The information collected through cookies can in no way identify you by name. It is used exclusively for our own needs in order to improve the interactivity and performance of our website. In accordance with the recommendations of the French data protection authority (CNIL), certain cookies are exempt from prior consent insofar as they are strictly necessary for the operation of the website or have the sole purpose of enabling or facilitating electronic communication. These cookies are fully subject to this policy insofar as they are issued and managed by Chalon dans la rue.

This requirement concerns cookies issued by third parties and qualified as “persistent” insofar as they remain on your device until they are erased or expire.

Since such cookies are issued by third parties, their use and placement are subject to their own privacy policies, a link to which you will find below. This family of cookies includes audience measurement cookies and social network sharing cookies (notably from Facebook, YouTube, Twitter and LinkedIn).

Audience measurement cookies produce statistics on the traffic to and use of various elements of the website (such as the content and pages you have visited). This data helps improve the ergonomics of the Chalon dans la rue website. One audience measurement tool is used on this website: Matomo, which is hosted on the server of the site's service provider.
Matomo respects the “Do not track” option that you can enable in your browser to tell the sites you visit that you do not wish to be tracked.

Matomo generates a cookie with a unique identifier, whose retention period is limited to 13 months. Your IP address is also collected, in order to determine the country from which you connect. It is immediately anonymized. For more information on how Matomo handles privacy, see the dedicated page.
c. You have various tools for configuring cookies

Most Internet browsers are set by default to allow cookies. Your browser gives you the option to change these standard settings so that all cookies are systematically rejected, or only some cookies are accepted or refused depending on who issues them.

selection-in.title: In Selection - Chalon Dans la Rue

blocks.text: CHALON DANS LA RUE FESTIVAL
The IN Selection follows the artistic line carried year-round by the National Center for Street Arts and Public Space (CNAREP) of Chalon-sur-Saône.

Artistic creation is conceived there as a unifying act, to be placed at the heart of our social interactions, in order to meet all audiences and produce shared artistic adventures where sharing drives creativity. The shows of the IN Selection are programmed by Nathalie Cixous, director of the festival and of the CNAREP.

They offer an eclectic and committed panorama of contemporary creation and poetically explore public space in its geographic and physical dimensions, but also its political one. A popular and unifying event, a time that brings the profession together, Chalon dans la rue also remains the event of the authors and creators of street arts and public space, a festival both turned toward the future and a great witness to the history of street arts.

selection-off.title: Off Selection - Chalon Dans la Rue

blocks.text: CHALON DANS LA RUE FESTIVAL
The OFF Selection is one of the pillars of the Chalon dans la rue festival. It delivers a rich and teeming panorama of creation in public space.

Nearly 130 companies are selected here by the festival team, who pay particular attention to the diversity of styles, perspectives, disciplines and aesthetics. It is a rich and varied program that unfolds across the city.
Young companies mingle with historic ones, intimate creations with the biggest projects, live performance with digital or visual art installations.

The Off Selection also entrusts certain spaces to collectives of companies or cultural associations so they can be turned into convivial places. Companies team up, take over a site and transform it into a new universe with continuous shows, food and a guaranteed atmosphere.
NB - Off Selection companies come to perform with their own production means. If you live in Chalon and would like to support them by offering accommodation, it's here.

tandem.title: Authors in Tandem - Chalon Dans la Rue

blocks.text: Authors in Tandem - Street and Public Space Arts & Theater

A partner of the program since 2023, Chalon dans la rue continues its support for artistic exploration alongside ARTCENA.
Conceived as a meeting space between a playwright who has won the national grant for the creation of dramatic texts and an artist of street and public space arts, this program supports new explorations and research around dramatic writing.

During 5 to 6 weeks of residencies in the partner venues, the two authors share their universes, language and knowledge in order to enrich and distinguish their approaches. It is an unprecedented program that fosters crossovers (between arts, sectors and networks) and does not commit to producing a show, but can nevertheless give rise to collaborations meant to continue, possibly in the form of a creation.
During the Chalon dans la rue festival, discover the research lab showings of the two duos.

The place for all encounters!
In the very heart of Chalon-sur-Saône, push open the doors of the Festival Courtyard!
SIDE A - BY DAY:

During the day, it's the spot to meet, have a drink, grab a snack, chat and enjoy a convivial moment between two shows.
A place for meetings and exchanges, the Festival Courtyard also welcomes the press and performing arts professionals for discussions and meetings organized with several French and international cultural partners.
SIDE B: AT NIGHT

At the end of the day, the Festival Courtyard transforms into a party venue with In Selection shows unfolding in a supercharged atmosphere. At night, we push the walls out and turn the volume up: the Festival Courtyard sweeps you into a whirlwind of festive and surprising offerings!
Step into this unique environment, designed and built with the help of the Galpon teams and our volunteers!
Companies present
The In Selection takes over the Festival Courtyard to fire you up! Warm up your wrists and shake your calves, this is going to vibrate!
◉ C'hoari (Compagnie) - Distro
◉ Play me a dance - Névroses Banales
◉ Radio Kaizman - Last Party
Guest bands
The music program of the Festival Courtyard!

◉ RADIO TUTTI
Electro Trad / All audiences

After 8 years on tour with Radio Tutti & Barilla Sisters and more than 300 concerts across France, the duo of Pauline Rivière and Pierre Alexis Lavergne tightens into Radio Tutti and goes looking for a new repertoire by exploring lands already traveled: fed on the trance of Italian tarantellas and the whirlwind of Galician music, they orchestrate a wild ball, an electro fireworks display splashing across southern Europe.
Discover

◉ Oscar les vacances
Chanson-Pop / All audiences

If Dalida and Philippe Katerine had a son, he would be called Oscar les vacances. At the tip of his free pen, Oscar traces a luminous path where French chanson, electronic music and pop delirium meet, while questioning life's big themes: masculinity, adolescence, even the Apocalypse. Oscar les vacances is an intimate, explosive journey into the depths of our imaginations and our unspoken fantasies.
Discover

◉ Choffo Blazter
Electroclash-pop / All audiences

Choffo Blazter, born in Brittany, from revolutionary songs and folk tales set to music. These are languages that resist, mixed with electro clash and the various worlds of techno. Over fast rhythms and deep bass, Lucile loops and weaves French, Arabic, Breton and Gaelic. Heirs of the ghetto blaster, we make our origins rumble: a music in fusion, between joy and fire, that makes bodies boil.
Discover

◉ Shadavar
Hybrid bass / All audiences

Shadavar emits a spellbinding melody and propels you into a magnetic whirlwind to summon fire on the dance floor. She makes you dance everything you can't say, and invites you into a feverish trance. Trap, rap, reggaeton, Persian, Turkish and Greek music: Shadavar sweeps you into a dance that shakes and wakes you up!
Discover

◉ LATE.X.NOW
Electro-industrial / Dark Disco / Minimal Techno
Ages 16 and up

Late.X.Now unfolds dark, sensual electronics at the crossroads of Dark Disco, EBM and industrial music. Snares cracking on shiny latex, this black and sulfurous sound summons a parallel night, cold and humid, where bodies and machines fuse. In this alternative space, Nova offers us a cyberpunk sonic and visual universe - futuristic silhouette, cold neon, hypnotic rhythms - inviting the body to find its footing in dance again.
